lede: The biggest thing on the table this week is Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting, where a public hearing on extending a development vesting period sits alongside a work session on automated license plate reader cameras — two issues that touch property rights and civil liberties in ways worth showing up for. Across the valley, Ouray is wrestling with whether to hand its city police function over to the county sheriff starting January 1, and San Miguel County's Planning Commission kicks off a joint work session with the BOCC on an affordable housing code update. Shrek the Musical opens Thursday at the Sheridan, and Stoke the Vote lands Wednesday if you need a reason to get out mid-week.
